1.w: A prayer of David. Protect me, O God, for I have taken shelter in you.

2.w: I say to the Lord , “You are the Lord, my only source of well-being.”

3.w: As for God’s chosen people who are in the land, and the leading officials I admired so much —

4.w: their troubles multiply; they desire other gods. I will not pour out drink offerings of blood to their gods, nor will I make vows in the name of their gods.

5.w: Lord , you give me stability and prosperity; you make my future secure.

6.w: It is as if I have been given fertile fields or received a beautiful tract of land.

7.w: I will praise the Lord who guides me; yes, during the night I reflect and learn.

8.w: I constantly trust in the Lord ; because he is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.

9.w: So my heart rejoices and I am happy; my life is safe.

10.w: You will not abandon me to Sheol; you will not allow your faithful follower to see the Pit.

11.w: You lead me in the path of life. I experience absolute joy in your presence; you always give me sheer delight.
